tables.title: Gathering rules
rows: Always aim to fell every tree and vein in one hit; power comes first until you can.
First 7 levels into power, then the first EXP node on the bottom row, then top-row power.
Top row completely. Runes and sacrifices add power on top.
Get woodcutting and mining curios, then respec: max the bottom row, then the middle row. Levelled curios replace the lost power.

The middle row maxed gives 36% gathering crit chance and +76% to +92% crit damage. Offline income counts crits as extra power, which is why the late-game advice is bottom row fully, then middle row fully. With it maxed, about 240,000 woodcutting and 275,000 mining fell every Nightmare Act 2 tree and vein in one hit.
Gathering levels matter for the flat power in the top row; farm XP or use hourglasses if they lag far behind combat.
Give every character an axe: Act 2 ash needs a great deal of wood.
